statement.name: GetContentItems
statement.sql:
SELECT pnci.NVGNContentItemId as NvgnContentItemId , pnci.DisplayValue AS ContentItemDisplayValue , pnci.Description AS ContentItemDescription , pnci.CssClass AS ContentItemCssClass , pnci.ContentItemCOREPreDefinedPageId as ContentItemCorePreDefinedPageId , pnci.AdditionalQueryString , pnci.ContentToolTip AS ContentItemToolTip , pnci.HelpToolTip AS HelpToolTip , pnci.HelpFlag AS HasHelp , isnull(pnci.PermissionDeniedToolTip,'') as PermissionDeniedToolTip , convert(int,rpncipncs.DisplayOrder) AS ContentItemDisplayOrder , convert(int,rpncgpni.DisplayOrder) AS ContentGroupDisplayOrder , rpncipncs.Visible AS ContentItemVisible , IsPopUp
, pncs.NVGNContentSectionId as NvgnContentSectionId , convert(int,pncs.DisplayOrder) AS ContentSectionDisplayOrder , pncs.DisplayValue AS ContentSectionDisplayValue , pncs.Description AS ContentSectionDescription , pncs.SectionSize AS ContentSectionSize
, pncg.NVGNContentGroupId as NvgnContentGroupId , pncg.DisplayValue AS ContentGroupDisplayValue , pncg.Description AS ContentGroupDescription , CASE WHEN pncia.ResourceValue IS NOT NULL AND acp.PrivilegeId IS NULL THEN convert(bit,0) ELSE convert(bit,1) END AS Enabled , CASE WHEN pnci.ContentItemCOREPreDefinedPageId IS NOT NULL THEN isnull(replace(convert(VARCHAR(MAX), esdv.DimensionValue) + rtrim(ltrim(pcpdp.RelativeURL)), '{0}', ''),'#') ELSE pnci.NavigationURL END AS ContentItemFinalUrl FROM dbo.PFM_NVGN_ContentItem pnci
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_PFM_NVGN_Item rpncipni ON pnci.NVGNContentItemId = rpncipni.NVGNContentItemId JOIN dbo.PFM_NVGN_Item pni ON rpncipni.NVGNItemId = pni.NVGNItemId
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_PFM_NVGN_LocalItem rpncipni ON pnci.NVGNContentItemId = rpncipni.NVGNContentItemId JOIN dbo.PFM_NVGN_LocalItem pni ON rpncipni.NVGNLocalItemId = pni.NVGNLocalItemId
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup rpncipncs ON pnci.NVGNContentItemId = rpncipncs.NVGNContentItemId JOIN dbo.PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup pncg ON pncg.NVGNContentGroupId = rpncipncs.NVGNContentGroupId
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup_PFM_NVGN_Item rpncgpni ON rpncgpni.NVGNItemId = pni.NVGNItemId AND rpncgpni.NVGNContentGroupId = pncg.NVGNContentGroupId
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup_PFM_NVGN_LocalItem rpncgpni ON rpncgpni.NVGNLocalItemId = pni.NVGNLocalItemId AND rpncgpni.NVGNContentGroupId = pncg.NVGNContentGroupId
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_PFM_NVGN_ContentSection rpncipncs ON pnci.NVGNContentItemId = rpncipncs.NVGNContentItemId JOIN dbo.PFM_NVGN_ContentSection pncs ON rpncipncs.NVGNContentSectionId = pncs.NVGNContentSectionId JOIN dbo.PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup pncg ON pncg.NVGNContentGroupId = pncs.NVGNContentGroupId
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup_PFM_NVGN_Item rpncgpni ON rpncgpni.NVGNItemId = pni.NVGNItemId AND rpncgpni.NVGNContentGroupId = pncg.NVGNContentGroupId
JOIN dbo.Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup_PFM_NVGN_LocalItem rpncgpni ON rpncgpni.NVGNLocalItemId = pni.NVGNLocalItemId AND rpncgpni.NVGNContentGroupId = pncg.NVGNContentGroupId
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.PFM_CORE_PreDefinedPage pcpdp ON pnci.ContentItemCOREPreDefinedPageId = pcpdp.COREPreDefinedPageId LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ExternalSystemDimensionValue esdv ON pcpdp.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = esdv.ExternalSystemDimensionCode AND pcpdp.ExternalSystemCode = esdv.ExternalSystemCode LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_Access pncia ON pnci.NVGNContentItemId = pncia.NVGNContentItemId LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AC_Permission acp ON ((convert(varchar(500), acp.PrivilegeId) = pncia.ResourceValue AND pncia.ResourceTypeCode = ) or (convert(varchar(500),acp.RoleId) = pncia.ResourceValue AND pncia.ResourceTypeCode = )) AND acp.UserId =
AND acp.ResourceTypeCode =
AND acp.ResourceValue =
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_Access_DomainSpecific pnciads ON pnci.NVGNContentItemId = pnciads.NVGNContentItemId
